statements.statement: SPDPbuiltinParticipantWriter sends DATA submessages carrying SPDPdiscoveredParticipantData.
SPDPbuiltinParticipantReader processes received SPDP DATA and maintains participant discovery state.
If refresh is not received within leaseDuration, the remote participant is considered gone and removed.
After lease expiry removal, a subsequent SPDP announcement from the same participant GUID is treated as a fresh discovery.
Peer table capacity is bounded; additional peers beyond RTPS_MAX_PEERS are rejected without corrupting existing entries.

A discovered participant keeps at most RTPS_MAX_PEER_LOCATORS locators per metatraffic unicast and default unicast list, and no multicast list; locator kinds the stack cannot send to are not kept, and without local addresses to rank against, kept locators stay in announced order.

A discovered participant's metatraffic and default unicast lists are kept most reachable first against the local addresses and prefixes (on link, IPv6 link-local, routed, unlikely; loopback of another host, unspecified, multicast and non-UDP locators dropped), in announced order within a class, ranked across every locator the announcement lists however many precede the most reachable one, and re-ranked on each announcement (RFC 6724 §6, RFC 3927 §2.7).
SPDP well-known multicast and metatraffic unicast ports follow the PB+DG*domainId+d formula.
SPDP multicast locators map to 239.255.0.1 for IPv4 and FF02::FFFF:239.255.0.1 for IPv6.
PL_CDR parameter lists are parsed until PID_SENTINEL; unknown PIDs are skipped without aborting parsing.
SPDP participant identity is derived from PID_PARTICIPANT_GUID and treated as mandatory by this implementation.
When parsed participant GUID prefix is unknown, reader falls back to RTPS header senderGuidPrefix for peer identity.
